overdispersion.interpretation: The statistic sits inside the null distribution, so this snapshot contains no detectable club-level variance beyond what scoring already explains. A leaderboard ranked on these 8-9 game records would be ranking noise.
overdispersion.null_hypothesis: Pythagorean win probability is the true per-game probability and games are independent within a club.

streak_note: Under a true 50% rate, one bettor in 32 wins 5 in a row by chance alone. A streak is not evidence of skill, and this table is why a leaderboard must not reward small samples.
